subject: POC readout & final decision - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks + next steps from today's call

Hi Sarah / David -

Thanks for taking the time today - great conversation and clear alignment on what success looks like for the POC. Quick recap and immediate next steps so we have everything captured: 

POC scope and success criteria (agreed):
- Ingest and serve our 1M-patient anonymized dataset via Redwood Private (VPC) with <150ms 95th-percentile latency for typical query patterns.
- End-to-end cost per 1k requests below the target you shared ($6.50).
- Model outputs meet QA pass rate >= 92% against your clinical prompt set (see attached pass/fail definitions).

Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Aug 15: POC kick-off & environment delivery (Redwood to provision VPC test enclave).
- Aug 16-26: Evaluation window (10 business days) - Acme runs test scenarios and we collect telemetry.
- Aug 26 (EOD): Final readout deck + metrics.
- Aug 27: Exec-level go/no-go review (Acme execs + Redwood CS/SE) and decision on next contract step.

Owners / contacts:
- Acme exec sponsor: David Lee (david.lee@acmehealth.com).
- Acme SRE / test lead: Sarah Thompson (sarah.thompson@acmehealth.com).
- Redwood SE lead: Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwood.com).
- Redwood AE: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com).

Immediate asks for Acme (before Aug 15):
1) Provide test dataset access details (S3 or VPN) + a short sample of the clinical prompts you plan to run.
2) Confirm the list of execs who will attend the Aug 27 review (title + email).

Attachments: acme-poc-success-criteria.xlsx (success criteria + QA pass/fail), redwood-poc-kickoff-checklist.md (kickoff checklist).

Happy to adjust if I missed anything - looking forward to the kick-off.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: David Lee <david.lee@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks + next steps from today's call

Thanks Marcus - this looks good. A couple quick clarifications: 

- We can start the POC on Aug 15 as suggested; our SRE will provide S3 credentials to a scrubbed dataset by COB Aug 13.
- For success criteria, please add an item for data handling: all PHI fields must be masked prior to logs leaving our environment (we'll want an attestation).
- Exec attendees for Aug 27: David Lee (SVP Product), Priya Natarajan (CFO), and me.

We'll aim to run the full clinical prompt set on Aug 19 and Aug 24 so you have interim reads.

One request - can Redwood provide a short one-page template for the Aug 26 readout (metrics and go/no-go checklist)? That will help our execs.

Best,
Sarah
Senior SRE, Acme Health

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme POC - resource ask + pricing check

Team -

FYI / internal plan following Acme call. External confirms S3 creds by Aug 13 and wants kickoff Aug 15. Key asks:

1) Neha - can you confirm SE availability for Aug 15 (kickoff) and interim reads on Aug 19 and Aug 24? Also need a one-page readout template and the final deck (I'll need the PDF by Aug 26 EOD).

2) Rishi - can you confirm trial credits and whether we can offer a 30% trial usage credit for the evaluation window? Acme is price-sensitive; we should see if we can put an offer in the readout if they go to production.

3) Marissa - if this goes well, potential mid-six-figure deal; can you prep an initial commercial terms slide for the deck (T&Cs, timeline to contract)?

I'm attaching the initial success criteria doc that Sarah flagged; Neha please add technical annotations.

Thanks - I'll keep you posted as Sarah confirms the dataset access.

Marcus
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Acme POC - resource ask + pricing check

Thanks Marcus - SE schedule confirmed: I'll own kickoff on Aug 15 and do the interim reads on Aug 19 and Aug 24. Quick notes for the kickoff and POC: 

- Test harness: we'll deploy a local inference endpoint in the VPC and provide a telemetry dashboard (token-level latency, cost per request, per-prompt QA).
- Data handling: we'll provide an attestation template for PHI masking; logs sent to Redwood will be redacted per the attestation.
- Quota: request a temporary capacity reservation of 2x baseline for the evaluation window to ensure we hit latency targets during parallel runs.

Attachments I've uploaded to the shared Drive: redwood-final-readout-deck.pdf (starter deck) and acme-poc-success-criteria.xlsx (annotated).

I'll also prepare the one-page readout template Marcus requested and send it by Aug 20.

-Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@acmehealth.com>, David Lee <david.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final readout scheduling + decision process (Aug 26-27)

Hi Sarah / David -

Quick update and confirmation ahead of kickoff:

- Redwood will be ready to provision the VPC test enclave on Aug 15 (Neha confirmed).
- We'll run interim telemetry reports on Aug 19 and Aug 24.
- Final readout deck will be delivered by Aug 26 EOD.
- Exec-level review scheduled for Aug 27 at 10:00 AM PT. Please confirm attendees; you previously listed David, Priya Natarajan (CFO) and Sarah.

Decision process for Aug 27 (proposed):
- 10:00-10:15: Quick summary + metrics (Neha + Marcus).
- 10:15-10:35: Discussion on quality/regressions (Acme QA + Neha).
- 10:35-10:50: Commercial proposal + next steps (Marissa).
- 10:50-11:00: Exec decision & action items (Acme execs).

If Acme gives a go, next contract step will be Redwood's standard Dedicated reservation order (Marissa will prepare the initial terms). We'll provide a DocuSign link for signature and a proposed timeline to onboard to Dedicated.

Link to preliminary deck and attachments: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C4D
DocuSign (proposal placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/FAKE_LINK

Please confirm attendees and whether the 10:00 AM PT time works for your execs.

Best,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
